steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary instead of creating or searching for an event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where submission-time settings are available.
Choose Fixed and set the new submission end to 30 minutes after the current end; the step verifies the saved end-time sum.
